changes: ASCII output and encoder retained unchanged; added synthetic-trained 63-class letter/digit and 17-class arithmetic uint8 heads sharing the frozen encoder. Tesseract LSTM dictionary sections removed.

reviewHead.encoder: frozen ddddocr common_old ASCII encoder; original output retained
reviewHead.classes: CTC blank and 62 ASCII letters/digits, in original alphabet order
reviewHead.training: 3000 synthetic images; nine fonts; clean, touching, overlap, warp, lines, mixed
reviewHead.optimizer: AdamW, lr=0.0003, weight_decay=0.001, batch=48; CTC loss + 0.1*mean((W-W0)^2), gradient norm <=5
reviewHead.runtimeWeights: uint8 per-tensor affine quantization; shared original activation quantization
reviewHead.developmentSet: 192 synthetic images, seed 202611111; checkpoint selection only, no image used for training

arithmeticHead.encoder: frozen ddddocr common_old encoder; original and letter/digit outputs retained
arithmeticHead.training: 2000 locally rendered arithmetic expressions; four fonts, light/dark backgrounds, small rotation and sparse lines
arithmeticHead.optimizer: AdamW, lr=0.0003, weight_decay=0.001, batch=48; CTC loss + 0.1*mean((W-W0)^2), gradient norm <=5
arithmeticHead.runtimeWeights: uint8 per-tensor affine quantization; shared original activation quantization
